Dynamic Cost-, Latency- & Quality-Aware AI Inference Gateway

RouteIQ

RouteIQ is an intelligent inference gateway that dynamically routes every user request to the optimal AI model under strict latency, cost, and capability constraints. It saves up to 75% on inference expenditure while mathematically guaranteeing zero SLA violations and seamless failover.

USP 1 Hard Constraints

Mathematical SLA Enforcement

Every candidate is filtered through strict latency, budget, context, and capability gates before inference. Invalid models are rejected with 0 tolerance.

USP 2 Zero-Creep Failover

Shrinking-Budget Failover

When an endpoint slows or fails, elapsed time is deducted from the budget ($L_{\text{rem}} = L_{\text{orig}} - t_{\text{spent}}$), failing over without SLA breach.

USP 3 < 2.4ms Decision

Laya System 1 Decision Engine

Non-autoregressive complexity estimator classifies queries in microseconds. Rule 4 Uncertainty Hedging safely routes ambiguous prompts.
